name: read_memory_bytes
description:
Read bytes at a given address.

Only use this function if `get_global_variable_at` and `get_global_variable_by_name`
both failed.

memory_address.description: Address of the memory value to be read
memory_address.title: Memory Address

name: data_read_byte
description:
Read the 1 byte value at the specified address.

Only use this function if `get_global_variable_at` failed.

address.description: Address to get 1 byte value from
address.title: Address

name: data_read_word
description:
Read the 2 byte value at the specified address as a WORD.

Only use this function if `get_global_variable_at` failed.

address.description: Address to get 2 bytes value from
address.title: Address

name: data_read_dword
description:
Read the 4 byte value at the specified address as a DWORD.

Only use this function if `get_global_variable_at` failed.

address.description: Address to get 4 bytes value from
address.title: Address

name: data_read_qword
description:
Read the 8 byte value at the specified address as a QWORD.

Only use this function if `get_global_variable_at` failed.

address.description: Address to get 8 bytes value from
address.title: Address

name: data_read_string
description:
Read the string at the specified address.

Only use this function if `get_global_variable_at` failed.
